soft_recovery_degraded_to_ready.description: Recovery from degraded state to ready state (soft recovery via WasmLoader.softReset)
soft_recovery_degraded_to_ready.notes: Preserves compiled WASM binary; only clears engine state and error buffers

fast_recovery_failed_to_ready.description: Recovery from failed state to ready state (fast recovery via WasmLoader.softReset)
fast_recovery_failed_to_ready.notes: Direct state transition; WASM already compiled so no fetch/compile overhead

cold_start_bootstrap_to_ready.description: Cold start from uninitialized to ready (full bootstrap with WASM load)
cold_start_bootstrap_to_ready.notes: Dominated by WASM binary fetch/load/compile; includes kernel init

circuit_breaker_open_to_closed.description: Circuit breaker state recovery (open → half-open → closed)
circuit_breaker_open_to_closed.notes: Depends on clock advancement and probe success; typically very fast

warning.action: Logged as warning; allows merge with maintainer review

recovery_paths_tested.name: failed → ready
recovery_paths_tested.mechanism: Direct state transition with WASM rollback
